conta.sairRapidoAjuda: Erases what Alumia stored on this device and opens an ordinary outside page (the weather forecast), with nothing from the Institute.

linha.ordem: In order of arrival, no algorithm
linha.fimTexto: Nothing more from the people you follow for now. No endless scrolling: how about a community or an action?

cartao.regraDoSelo: The badge says the account belongs to who it claims to be, checked against a public document. It is not an endorsement by the Institute.
cartao.obra: Work from the Instituto Lúcia collection
cartao.indisponivel: This arrives with the next Alumia update.
cartao.naoRepostavel: You can only repost someone else's post written for everyone (not a reply, nor a post for a smaller group).

enquete.secreto: Secret ballot: nobody sees how you voted.

escrever.longoComo: What kind of long text is this?
escrever.corpo: Take your time: up to 10 thousand characters.
escrever.codinome: You post as {codinome}. Your dashboard name never shows.
escrever.atoSemFormulario: Calling an action arrives with the next Alumia update.
escrever.desfeito: Sending undone. Your text is back in the box.
escrever.descartarResposta: Discard this reply? The text will not be saved.
escrever.rascunhoSoAqui: For now the draft stays only on this device.
escrever.rascunhosAjuda: We keep up to 20, and each one is deleted after 30 days. Only you see them.
escrever.semAlt: An image has no description: screen reader users won't know what's in it. Describe it, or tap again to post as is.
escrever.naoDesfez: Could not undo: the post was already published. You can delete it from the post menu.
escrever.rascunhosCheios: You already have 20 drafts in your account: this one stays only on this device. Delete one to save it to your account.
escrever.ajudaInternet: Anyone, also on Mastodon, Lemmy, Misskey and the rest of the Fediverse.
escrever.ajudaMembros: Only people with an Alumia account.
escrever.rodaEmBreve: Your trust list arrives with the new profile. Nobody learns who is on it.
escrever.notaFediverso: Also on the Fediverse: the post goes to people who follow you on Mastodon, Lemmy and Misskey, under your codename.
escrever.tipoAnuncio: {tipo} selected. The main button now says “{botao}”.
escrever.textoGuardado: Your text is kept: it comes back if you switch to Post, Poll or Long text.

direita.fediTexto: People on Mastodon, Lemmy and Misskey follow you and reply right here, in the same feed. Your address:
direita.fediSemNome: Choose a @name on your profile to get your address.
direita.rodape: Order of arrival · no ads · no tracking · always a codename

previa.aviso: Preview with sample data. Nothing here is real and nothing is posted.
previa.voceNoMosaicoResto: (the golden card). Each lit card is someone who confirmed; the more people, the sharper the word.
previa.mosaico: Mosaic for the action {palavra}: each lit card is a confirmation.
previa.salaEmBreve: The live room arrives with the next stage of Alumia.
previa.mosaicoApagado: The mosaic starts dark and lights up with each person who confirms.

b1.avisoAjuda: Readers see only the warning; the text and images stay covered until they tap.
b1.sempreAbrir: Always open “{aviso}” warnings on this device
b1.abreSozinho: “{aviso}” warnings open by themselves on this device.
b1.imagemCoberta: Image covered by the content warning
b1.altSemModelo: Alumia never sends your image to any AI: the description is yours. Say what matters to someone who can't see it.
b1.soNoFimAjuda: Nobody sees partial results, not even you: in an assembly, partial results sway the vote.
b1.embaralharAjuda: Each person sees the options in their own order: the first one gets no advantage.
b1.resultadoNoFim: Results appear when the poll closes.
b1.citarFechado: The author doesn't allow quoting this post.
b1.citaAjudaNinguem: Only you can quote it. This is the default: your post doesn't become ammunition unless you want it to.
b1.citaAjudaSeguindo: Only people you follow can repost it with a comment.
b1.citaAjudaTodos: Anyone who can see the post can repost it with a comment.
b1.naContaAjuda: Off, drafts stay only on this device. On, they go encrypted: the server keeps only scrambled data and can't read it.
b1.naContaDesligou: Drafts deleted from your account. From now on, only on this device.
b1.rascunhoCifrado: Draft saved in your account, encrypted on this device.
b1.rascunhoOutroAparelho: Encrypted on another device: you need that device's code.
b1.rascunhoAntigo: Saved earlier, without encryption. Continue it to encrypt, or delete it.
b1.rascunhoDeAto: Action drafts stay only on this device.
b1.chaveAjuda: This code is the key to your drafts. Anyone with the code can read them: keep it like a password and don't send it by message.
b1.chaveInvalida: That code isn't a drafts key.
b1.chaveTrocada: Done: this device can now read the other device's drafts.
b1.pausaTexto: You've been scrolling for {n} minutes. The struggle needs rest too.
b1.pausaSobre: The reminder lives only on this device: nothing is counted or sent.
b1.abaInicialFeita: On this device, Alumia opens on “{aba}”.
b1.aposAtoNenhum: You haven't called any action for the next 30 days.
b1.aposAtoQuando: Goes out when “{ato}” ends ({quando}). If the action is postponed, the post waits too.
b1.repetirSemArquivo: A repeating post can't carry images or audio.
b1.corrigirAjuda: For safety: add a warning, describe an image or remove a photo that shows someone who shouldn't appear.
b1.tirarConfirmar: Remove image {n} from the post? It disappears for everyone.
b1.fediverso: To go out to the Fediverse, post in a community open to the internet.

erros.citar_fechado: The author doesn't allow quoting this post.
erros.rascunho_sem_cifra: The draft stayed only on this device.
erros.invalido:ato: That action isn't yours, was cancelled or is already over.
erros.repetir_sem_arquivo: A repeating post can't carry images or audio.
